Sanguine Orb
Instant cast8 sec cooldown
Consumes 1 Reaped Soul
Create a Sanguine Orb for up to 10 sec, increasing all Healing you take by 8%, and reducing the Mana Cost of your abilities by 15%.

The next time you use an offensive ability that consumes a percentage of your Maximum Health, you will instantly be Healed for 12% of your Maximum Health.
